# Forest

> Forest is a productivity app that helps users maintain focus and minimize smartphone distractions through gamification and virtual rewards.

Forest combines focus timer technology with engaging gamification mechanics to help users build better focus habits. The app uses virtual tree-planting as a reward system to encourage sustained concentration and time management.
